mapper.select: select * from warehouse order by id asc

select count(*) from warehouse
where warehouse_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or warehouse_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(location, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(cast(capacity_ton as char), '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(manager_name, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(status, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')

select id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, location, capacity_ton, manager_name, contact_phone, status, grain_type, remark, created_at, updated_at from warehouse where status != 'DISABLED' order by id asc
select * from warehouse where id = #{id} limit 1
select * from warehouse where warehouse_code = #{warehouseCode} limit 1
select count(*) from warehouse where status = 'ACTIVE'
select count(*) from warehouse where status != 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into warehouse ( warehouse_code, warehouse_name, location, capacity_ton, manager_name, contact_phone, status, grain_type, remark ) values ( #{warehouseCode}, #{warehouseName}, #{location}, #{capacityTon}, #{managerName}, #{contactPhone}, #{status}, #{grainType}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: update warehouse set warehouse_code = #{warehouseCode}, warehouse_name = #{warehouseName}, location = #{location}, capacity_ton = #{capacityTon}, manager_name = #{managerName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, status = #{status}, grain_type = #{grainType}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
